description: Returns whether the authenticated user is currently clocked in (has an active mobile clock session with no clock-out time). Use when the user asks 'am I clocked in?', 'is my time being tracked?', 'did I clock in today?'. Available to all authenticated roles.
name: is_clocked_in

clock_in_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the active clock-in, or null if not clocked in

is_clocked_in.description: True if the user currently has an active clock-in session

title: Is Clocked In
